title: Future.await throws exception when used in blockingHandler with ThreadingModel.VIRTUAL_THREAD
body:
### Version

`4.5.13`

### Context

I have been playing around with Virtual Threads, trying to find the best way to use them in my project.  I was using `Thread.sleep` to simulate delays in a HTTP request, and noticed the performance was not as I expected.

After playing around with `Future.await`, I noticed an exception is thrown when it is used in a `.blockingHandler`.  This does not happen when used in a normal `.handler`.  The `Future` that is passed to `Future.await` still seems to run.

I'm not entirely sure if this is a bug, but thought I would report it just in-case.

### Do you have a reproducer?

https://gist.github.com/MrBurtyyy/ed36b1f1709c5ba8ab1f56c8175c755e

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a Verticle that spins up an `HttpServer`
2. Deploy Verticle with `ThreadingModel.VIRTUAL_THREAD`
3. Create a `.blockingHandler` that uses `Future.await`
4. Call endpoint - exception is thrown

### Extra

- Windows 11 Home
- Java 21.0.5 2024-10-15 LTS

Stack Trace:

```
java.lang.IllegalStateException: null
	at io.vertx.core.impl.TaskQueue.continuationTask(TaskQueue.java:109) ~[vertx-core-4.5.13.jar:4.5.13]
	at io.vertx.core.impl.TaskQueue.suspend(TaskQueue.java:323) ~[vertx-core-4.5.13.jar:4.5.13]
	at io.vertx.core.impl.WorkerExecutor.suspend(WorkerExecutor.java:94) ~[vertx-core-4.5.13.jar:4.5.13]
	at io.vertx.core.Future.await(Future.java:675) ~[vertx-core-4.5.13.jar:4.5.13]
```

comments.body: thanks for reporting this is a valid concern that should be addressed with a proper fix
